name: Gloria
self_text: I'm Gloria, a non-binary Egyptian in my late 20s. I love urban gardening for the peace it brings. I play Tidewatch on console and mostly focus on ranked matches. I don't do coaching. Most weeks, I'm available on Saturday morning.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into ranked matches. I'd strongly prefer that you are available Saturday morning, though it's not a requirement. It would be a small bonus if you are into Hollow Lantern or Tidewatch.
